content:
Fortnite has relaunched on iPhone in Brazil today with the launch of the Epic Games Store. However, Epic Games is unhappy with the nine steps required to access it.

Epic Games has announced the launch of the iPhone version of the Epic Games Store in Brazil today:

The Epic Games Store is now available on iPhones in Brazil. Download now to play Fortnite and Rocket League Sideswipe. When you spend in Fortnite through the Epic Games Store, you can get 20% back in Epic Rewards — a discount that Apple's rules prevent us from offering you on the Brazilian App Store. Jump straight into the latest Fortnite Battle Royale season, "Runners," or explore more than 345,000 games made by developers using the Unreal Editor for Fortnite (UEFN).

However, in another post, Epic Games explained the multi-step process for accessing the Epic Games Store on iPhone in Brazil. Epic Games said Apple is intentionally making it difficult for users.

This situation may change in the future, as Epic Games continues to push for fewer steps.

While you wait, you can read the full announcement here and find an access tutorial for playing Fortnite on iPhone in Brazil.
